item.title: Trump arrives in Philippines to kick off Asia trip
item.description:
President Donald Trump is in Asia for historic talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin this week, with nuclear arms reductions and Iran on the agenda and Trump signaling Monday that he also plans to raise Russia's war in Ukraine. Trump's trip began Tuesday in the Philippines at the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) summit before he travels to Shenzhen, China, for Thursday's meeting with Xi and Putin on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit. The rare gathering comes amid simmering U.S.-China trade tensions and ongoing conflicts involving Russia and Iran, with Trump signaling plans to raise denuclearization and efforts to end the fighting. item.title: China, Canada agree to further reduce tariffs at APEC summit in Shenzhen
item.description:
China agreed to cut some levies on imports from Canada, as Ottawa looks to reduce its trade reliance on the US. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney hailed “ greater predictability and stability ” in relations with Beijing after talks with China’s leader Xi Jinping. Still, though Carney has made diversifying away from the US a key pillar of his trade policy, Canada’s exports to its southern neighbor have actually in recent months. Mexico’s president — who also met with Xi on Tuesday — has likewise sought to reduce her country’s dependence on Washington. But while President Donald Trump’s tariffs have upended global geopolitics, the US’ biggest trade partners are struggling to undo decades of supply chain integration. — Jeronimo Gonzalez

item.title: Is the US-Israel war on Iran turning into a ‘frozen conflict’?
item.description:
Iran has been an inhospitable setting for journalists for a long time. Last year, Reporters Without Borders classified the country as 176th out of 180 for press freedom. But the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran has made the situation even more precarious for reporters. A couple of weeks ago, I heard from a source in Iran I had interviewed for my report about the nationwide protests of early 2026. After this person purchased a Starlink terminal, both to maintain internet access during periodic blackouts and to continue working as an online language teacher, law enforcement officials detected the signals and seized the equipment in a raid. The officers sifted through my contact's personal communications and found out about the exchange we had had.
